title: The librarian, from behind
logline: The reading room, and for once a person in it: the librarian, from behind, gray cardigan, at the archive shelf with the box that says (finch), one hand on it. The only other person the sequence draws.

panels.composition: The library's back room: metal shelves, and a woman in a gray cardigan seen from behind with one hand resting on a gray archive box pulled a few inches out, the green lamp on the table behind her.
